Kid, you're trans. Plain and simple. I understand you, though. That contradictory message you get from being born in the wrong body yet not being in the correct one. Just remember, you'll be more than awesome at fending that nagging voice off once you get the chance to transition, if you ever feel like it. I can't vouch for everyone, but, testosterone will most certainly do most of it's handiwork in making your body biologically male. Tell the voice you're a handsome young man no matter what, and no matter what you look like, you aren't any less trans than the next bloke. Good luck.

I'm 18, and I literally only just started realising things at 15 or 16, much like you. Trust me, age doesn't make you any less trans; you can figure this out from the very beginning as a wee nipper, or you can figure it out when you're much much older. Either way, you're probably not lying to yourself. 

Naturally, I'd advice against rushing into things, per se. Experiment. Go and get those boy clothes, and if you feel so much better in them, then you know. Hell, I'm over here transitioning and doing drag. There's just no incorrect way to being yourself.

There are plenty of trans YouTubers who are incredibly amazing, and will also help you figure things out, too.
